verdict.rationale: AgentMail publishes an API reference page (docs-32 at api-reference.md) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe-2). Hands-on reports describe code examples that switch between languages such as Python and curl (comm-5), and dashboard popovers that show SDK examples (comm-16). Nothing in the pack shows that the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in place, such as a 'try it' console that executes live requests. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable in-browser request execution, independent corroboration of the reference experience
